title: AgentResponse
description: The agent's answer to one message: status 200, content-type application/json, the replies to send, in order. An empty list sends nothing. Keys other than `replies` are ignored.

replies.description: Sent to the person one after another. Each is checked on its own against what the run's platform can show (see x-chinwag-platforms in agent-endpoint.openapi.yaml): one that does not fit is not sent and the run says why; the others still go.

message.description: A message to the person. Only the keys below: any other key is refused as something the platform does not show. Not allowed together: `link` with `buttons` or `list`; `image` with `list`. With `image`, `text` is its caption.

text.description: At most the platform's maxLength (4,000 where it sets none).

replyTo.description: Quote one of the person's messages, by its messageId (such as m3). Platforms with replies only.

buttons.description: Reply buttons; a tap comes back as the person's message, with `choice`. Platforms with buttons only, within their max and labelMax.

list.description: A list the person picks one row from; the pick comes back with `choice`. Platforms with lists only, within their maxRows, titleMax and buttonMax.

button.description: The label that opens the list.

link.description: A page by https URL: a button where the platform has linkButton (label within its labelMax), else the URL goes on a line after the text (label at most 20 characters).

image.description: A photo by https URL, `text` its caption (within the platform's captionMax). Where the platform has no images, the text goes alone.

fields.description: The channel's own parameters, passed on as they are.

read.description: The agent has picked these messages up (read receipts, where the platform shows them).

reaction.description: An emoji reaction on one of the person's messages, by its messageId (platforms with reactions).

template.description: A WhatsApp template the owner set up, sent as is, even outside the 24-hour window. Other keys are passed on.

header.description: { kind: text, text } or { kind: image | video | document, url? or fileId? }.

body.description: Values for the body's {{1}}, {{2}}, ... in order.

buttons.description: Values for the buttons that take one, by position from 0.

variables.description: The body's values by number ({ "1": "Maria" }), the older form of `body`.

status.description: A short line of what the agent is doing, in the loading indicator (platforms with status); null clears it.

typing.description: Show or stop the typing indicator.
